title: Сложное дополнение: want him to do, make/let him do, see him doing

why: Когда мы хотим сказать, что один человек хочет, чтобы другой что-то сделал, заставил или разрешил ему это, в русском нам нужна придаточная часть: «я хочу, чтобы ты пришёл». В английском всё короче: после глагола идёт сразу человек (в форме me, him, her, us, them), а затем глагол. Это сложное дополнение (object + infinitive).
formation: • want / expect / ask / tell / advise / allow + кто-то + to + глагол: I want you to help me.
• Отрицание: tell / ask + кто-то + not to + глагол: She told me not to touch it.
• make / let + кто-то + глагол БЕЗ to: The boss made us work. / She let him go.
• see / hear / watch / notice / feel + кто-то + глагол (целое действие) или V-ing (в процессе): I saw him cross the road. / I saw him crossing the road.
• Пассив с make: He was made to work late (в пассиве to возвращается).
• Вместо let в пассиве используем be allowed to: He was allowed to go.
usage: 1. Желание, просьба, совет: My manager wants me to finish today. (Начальник хочет, чтобы я закончил сегодня.)
2. Принуждение: The teacher made us repeat the text. (Учитель заставил нас повторить текст.)
3. Разрешение: Her parents let her stay out late. (Родители разрешили ей гулять допоздна.)
4. Восприятие: I heard someone playing the piano. (Я слышал, как кто-то играет на пианино.) I saw her enter the room. (Я видел, как она вошла в комнату.)
signalWords: want, would like, expect, ask, tell, advise, allow, get — потом to. make, let, have — без to. see, hear, watch, notice, feel — глагол или -ing.
mistakes: ✗ I want that you help me → ✓ I want you to help me. Здесь нет that и придаточной части.
✗ She made me to wait → ✓ She made me wait. После make и let частицы to нет.
✗ I want he comes → ✓ I want him to come. Нужно дополнение (him), а не подлежащее (he).
✗ He was made work late → ✓ He was made to work late. В пассиве после made частица to нужна.
✗ She told me don't touch it → ✓ She told me not to touch it. Отрицание — not to.
remember: want him TO do, но make him do и let him do. Видел процесс — see him doing.

items.prompt: My boss wants me ___ (finish) the report today.
items.answer: to finish

items.prompt: The teacher made us ___ (repeat) the text.
items.answer: repeat

items.prompt: Her parents let her ___ (stay) out late.
items.answer: stay

items.prompt: I saw him ___ (run) to the station. He was in a hurry.
items.answer: running / run

items.prompt: We expect them ___ (arrive) at noon.
items.answer: to arrive

items.prompt: The noise made the baby ___ (cry).
items.answer: cry

items.prompt: I heard someone ___ (play) the piano when I passed the house.
items.answer: playing / play

items.prompt: She asked me ___ (help) her with the project.
items.answer: to help

items.prompt: I want (a) that you call (b) you to call (c) you call me later.
items.answer: (b) you to call

items.prompt: They made him (a) to pay (b) pay (c) paying the fine.
items.answer: (b) pay

items.prompt: She let the children (a) to play (b) playing (c) play in the garden.
items.answer: (c) play

items.prompt: I watched the kids (a) to play (b) playing (c) played football for an hour.
items.answer: (b) playing

items.prompt: The doctor advised him (a) stop (b) to stop (c) stopping smoking.
items.answer: (b) to stop

items.prompt: He was made (a) work (b) to work (c) working overtime.
items.answer: (b) to work

items.prompt: Do you want me (a) help (b) to help (c) helping you?
items.answer: (b) to help

items.prompt: I felt the ground (a) to shake (b) shake (c) to shaking.
items.answer: (b) shake

items.prompt: 'Please send me the file,' Tom said to Anna. (asked)
items.answer: Tom asked Anna to send him the file.

items.prompt: 'You must wait here,' the guard said to us. (made)
items.answer: The guard made us wait here. / The guard made us wait there.

items.prompt: 'You can use my car,' Dad said to me. (let)
items.answer: Dad let me use his car.

items.prompt: I saw her. She was entering the building. (saw)
items.answer: I saw her entering the building. / I saw her enter the building.

items.prompt: 'Don't be late,' the manager told Sam. (told)
items.answer: The manager told Sam not to be late.

items.prompt: 'You may leave early,' she said to the students. (allowed)
items.answer: She allowed the students to leave early.

items.prompt: The film was so sad that I cried. (made)
items.answer: The film made me cry.

items.prompt: I heard Mike. He was singing in the shower. (heard)
items.answer: I heard Mike singing in the shower. / I heard Mike sing in the shower.

items.prompt: I want that you help me.
items.answer: I want you to help me.

items.prompt: She made me to wait for an hour.
items.answer: She made me wait for an hour.

items.prompt: They let us to enter the room.
items.answer: They let us enter the room.

items.prompt: I saw him to cross the road.
items.answer: I saw him cross the road. / I saw him crossing the road.

items.prompt: My manager wants that I work on weekends.
items.answer: My manager wants me to work on weekends.

items.prompt: He was made work late.
items.answer: He was made to work late.

items.prompt: I want he comes tomorrow.
items.answer: I want him to come tomorrow.

items.prompt: She told me don't touch it.
items.answer: She told me not to touch it.

items.prompt: Я хочу, чтобы ты мне помог.
items.answer: I want you to help me.

items.prompt: Начальник заставил нас работать в выходные.
items.answer: The boss made us work on the weekend. / The boss made us work on weekends. / The boss made us work at the weekend.

items.prompt: Родители не разрешили ему пойти на вечеринку.
items.answer: His parents didn't let him go to the party. / His parents didn't allow him to go to the party.

items.prompt: Я видел, как она выходила из офиса.
items.answer: I saw her leaving the office. / I saw her leave the office.

items.prompt: Врач посоветовал мне больше спать.
items.answer: The doctor advised me to sleep more.

items.prompt: Мы ожидаем, что клиент ответит завтра.
items.answer: We expect the client to reply tomorrow. / We expect the client to respond tomorrow. / We expect the client to answer tomorrow.

items.prompt: Я слышал, как кто-то плачет в соседней комнате.
items.answer: I heard someone crying in the next room. / I heard someone cry in the next room.

items.prompt: Попроси его не опаздывать.
items.answer: Ask him not to be late.
